The '''Selldu Rangers''', a specialized cavalry unit led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Orrimaarko/Legends|Orrimaarko]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dressel/Legends|Dressel]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], were crucial in the [[Dressellian resistance]] against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] occupation. Utilizing [[selldu]], two-legged, flightless [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavians]], the Rangers mastered guerrilla warfare with night raids on Imperial patrols and outposts. Under General Orrimaarko's leadership, the [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellians]], supported by the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], reverted to traditional lifestyles to evade reprisals and unify in an unprecedented cause. The Selldu Rangers, known for their powerful mounts and fearsome battle cries, became a symbol of resistance.<ref name="Stay on Target" />

==Behind the scenes==
Selldu Rangers were first mentioned in [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']], a [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook for the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] series.<ref name="Stay on Target" />
